violations.why: Orchid is enabled at line 11 and can preempt the task between the check and the reset, so the reset can overwrite its increment.
Once orchid has enabled pylon, pylon can preempt the task between the check and the reset and increment v_umber.
Interrupts are still enabled while fn_cobalt and init run, so quiver can modify v_umber after the task's write and before the later read.
The increment in addData is not atomic, and quiver (priority 3) can preempt orchid between the read and the write when it is enabled.
Pylon (priority 2) can preempt orchid between the read and the write of the increment, once it has been enabled by an earlier orchid run.
Quiver (priority 3) can preempt pylon in the middle of its increment, and the increment is then lost.
